metadata.citation: Wang et al. (2025). OPeRA: A Dataset of Observation, Persona, Rationale, and Action. arXiv:2506.05606.
metadata.events_note: Real participant shopping-session actions. click_type=purchase denotes a purchase-intent control click, not a confirmed order.
metadata.population_note: Research sample of human shopping sessions, not a full retailer event log or market-wide visitor sample.
metadata.split_note: Session-level chronological 80/20 split by session start time; sessions are not shared between train and test.
metadata.recommendation_methods: Session co-visitation, TF-IDF title similarity, cosine similarity and MMR diversity reranking.

evaluation.message: The available sample yields too few held-out next-product targets for reliable Recall/NDCG claims. No zero-filled or synthetic accuracy scores are displayed.
evaluation.split: chronological by whole session start time; 80% train / 20% test
